failure_policy.diagnostics_after_failure_only_if: Confirmed owner closed and independent saved terminal/stopped evidence permits postclosed read; do not call fault helper for unhandled reason. If stopping unconfirmed, record concrete condition and assess recovery.

rollback_policy.retain_candidate_if: Boot, communication and stopped acquisition confirmed, even if throughput trial fails.
restore_only_if: Candidate cannot boot/communicate after planned user replug
rollback_policy.recovery_target: Fresh complete SC64KiB snapshot pinned above; old SB remains additional untouched fallback, no automatic SB/S4 restore.
rollback_policy.procedure_if_needed: Root records concrete reason, writes pinned SC64KiB snapshot with verify, independent full65536-byte readback equal pinned SHA, Reset/Run and actual user replug; then SC-only100k READY helper without START.
rollback_policy.user_instruction: Do not return working firmware automatically when unnecessary.

audit_limits.cap_not_guaranteed_by_nominal_bytes: Logged read fragmentation adds13bytes per nonempty chunk plus controls; actual cap overflow is a host audit failure, not automatically device queue-full.
audit_limits.DWT_wrap: 5/30s record is not entire boot/procedure wall. Preserve external no-halt and actual timing; do not subtract rawDWT over more than one2^32 wrap (~59.65s).
